title: Edition-based demo publication: a Miami Beach local events site
description: Backlog (Ryan 2026-10-19). A demo publication that publishes in editions, to exercise the edition feature once it is an opt-in setting. Idea: a local events site for Miami Beach with natural cadence editions: Art Basel edition, Spring Music edition, Summer Festival edition. Depends on PPY-8b3b4d. Not started; YAGNI until then.
